# tebib_vpc (Resource)

A VPC: a private network, isolated from other projects. It gets a routed IPv6 range and its own DNS server. Every project also has a default VPC (see the `tebib_vpc` data source).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_vpc" "main" {
  name = "main"
  cidr = "10.1.0.0/16"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) Private IPv4 range, e.g. `10.1.0.0/16`. Changing it replaces the VPC.
- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's VPCs. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `dns_server` (String) The VPC's DNS server address.
- `has_nat_gateway` (Boolean) Whether the VPC has a NAT gateway.
- `id` (String) VPC ID (`vpc-...`).
- `ipv6_cidr` (String) The VPC's IPv6 range.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the project's default VPC.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> uses the provider's project; <project_id>/<id> names it.
tofu import tebib_vpc.main vpc-abc123
tofu import tebib_vpc.main p-def456/vpc-abc123
```
